purpose: Keep every Dominion lane productive through evidence-bound internal work while preserving Founder authority over consequential external effects.

lane_objectives.commerce_fulfillment: Revenue mission for the LIVE Dominion Revenue Work Plane and VoltEdge commerce funnel. EVIDENCE_POLICY=HYBRID. Treat the injected REVENUE_WORKPLANE_SNAPSHOT as authoritative current runtime evidence and never invent metrics. If visitors are zero, produce the highest-intent organic traffic and message-match package for the active experiment route. If impressions exist without clicks, diagnose hook, CTA, offer clarity, and message match. If clicks exist without paid purchases, diagnose product-page, trust, checkout, shipping, and offer friction. If purchases exist, protect attribution and revenue per visitor while preparing the next evidence-backed treatment. The separately governed Dominion Revenue Runtime may perform only reversible CRO allowed by governance/revenue_execution_policy.json. Do not publish through Buddy, contact customers, change price, submit supplier actions, spend, or weaken the revenue runtime policy.
lane_objectives.kdp_publishing: Prepare the next governed KDP production packet from available evidence: rights checklist, editorial/quality checks, metadata, cover requirements, pricing evidence gaps, demand evidence, differentiation, and publication readiness. Draft only. Do not upload or publish.
lane_objectives.analytics_services: Revenue mission for governed analytics services. EVIDENCE_POLICY=HYBRID. Research current buyer pain and commercial intent, produce a decision-ready sample audit/service package, positioning, qualification criteria, measurement plan, and proposal draft. Do not contact prospects or send proposals.
lane_objectives.digital_products: Revenue mission for owned digital products. EVIDENCE_POLICY=HYBRID. Identify the strongest evidence-backed buyer problem, product concept, offer, delivery requirements, landing-page draft, organic acquisition plan, and validation experiment. Do not publish, change price, or alter customer delivery.
lane_objectives.services_lead_generation: Research qualified service opportunities and prepare a ranked internal lead list plus proposal drafts and evidence. Do not contact prospects, submit proposals, accept contracts, or represent price or delivery dates externally.
lane_objectives.content_traffic: Revenue-support mission for the LIVE Dominion Revenue Work Plane. EVIDENCE_POLICY=HYBRID. Treat the injected REVENUE_WORKPLANE_SNAPSHOT as authoritative current funnel evidence. Produce the next buyer-intent SEO, short-form, video, CTA, and attribution package that routes qualified owned/organic traffic to the active experiment route. Use the current constraint: zero visitors means traffic acquisition first; impressions without clicks means message-match and hook work; clicks without purchases means pre-sell trust and objection work. Do not fabricate metrics, publish automatically through Buddy, use personal likeness without approval, spend, or make health/legal/income claims.
lane_objectives.surplus: Research one lawful surplus opportunity workflow or jurisdiction and prepare an internal evidence packet with eligibility, source citations, process map, unknowns, risk flags, and synthetic-case next step. Do not contact claimants, collect sensitive identity data, sign, file, or submit.
lane_objectives.trading: Research and evaluate paper-trading performance only. Produce an internal measurement packet covering sample size, drawdown, profit factor, setup quality, failure modes, and next paper-only test. Never place a live trade or change live risk permissions.
lane_objectives.intelligence_orchestration: Perform a system status and orchestration review with the LIVE Dominion Revenue Work Plane as a production dependency. Treat the injected REVENUE_WORKPLANE_SNAPSHOT as authoritative for the active experiment, funnel constraint, runtime status, and evaluator state. Identify stale queues, blocked traffic handoffs, missing evidence, duplicate scheduling, and the single highest-value routing correction that can be prepared internally without changing governance or production authority.
lane_objectives.governance_legal: Review current internal production state for governance gaps, unresolved evidence conflicts, unowned work, and approval-boundary risks. Prepare a remediation packet only; do not sign, file, publish legal material, disclose sensitive data, or change policy automatically.
lane_objectives.infrastructure: Perform a system health and production-readiness review using current internal evidence, including dominion-revenue-runtime.service and dominion-revenue-evaluator.timer when REVENUE_WORKPLANE_SNAPSHOT is injected. Identify degraded components, stale receipts, backup/rollback gaps, and the highest-value safe remediation proposal. Do not deploy, rotate secrets, delete data, or change DNS/networking automatically.
